topic.title: Reviews Search
topic.shortdesc: Use the Reviews tab to search for files that contain review comments within the entire project.

body.p: In the Reviews tab within the Workspace Search view, you can use the search text field at the top to search for text within review comments and other review items. Use the Filters button next to the search field to open a pop-up where you can set values for the following filters:

ul.li: Type - The type of review item (for example, comment or highlight). Default: All.
Status - The status of the review item (Open or Done).
Author - The user who wrote the review. Default: Anyone.

Mentioned user - Restricts results to review items that contain an @-mention of the selected user (not just any occurrence of the name in text). The list is built from mentions indexed in the task. New mentions appear after re-indexing. Matching is case-insensitive. The current user is listed first in the list. See for how to add mentions in comments. To find reviews where you are mentioned, see . Default: Anyone.
Time - The time range for the review. Default: All Time.

body.p: When you have one or more filters set, they appear as chips below the search field (each chip shows the filter icon and value). The Filters button may also show a badge when filters are active.

Results are ordered by date (newest first). Each result shows the date, author, document title, and relative file path. For comments, the topic text where the review was added is also shown. Click a result to open the file in the visual editor.
The Clear Index button that appears at the bottom-right corner of the Search view resets the entire project indexing data. You can start a new search to re-index the project content.
